cases.note: the TRAIT half of this receiver, written as the file's SECOND declaration. The grammar's <file> opens with a detached annotation run (authoring-rules 7b) that at token level cannot be told from the first declaration's own preamble, so an annotated trait at the top of a file derives with <trait-annotation> blanked. Only one written below another declaration holds that production to anything.

cases.message: @disabled on a spec or trait takes no arguments
